thread:
erin: noticed several reseller orgs with preview_cost >> ledger_cost starting at 02:12 UTC. No invoice spikes yet.

josh: which enrichments changed recently?

erin: enrich-service pushed v3.1.0 at 01:58 UTC, added `metering_metadata.v2` field. Preview pipeline schema validation still expects v1.

sam: quick grep in preview-agg: we call `normalize_plan(event.plan, event.metering)` and assume metering_metadata is flat. v2 nested the discount under `metering_metadata.discount.value`. That causes parse to return 0 discount -> inflated preview.

billing-bot: alert: preview_to_ledger_ratio alert for group=resellers threshold=10 -> orgs: R-55,R-101

devex: UX risk: customers see scary preview numbers. Can we show a small banner: "Preview estimates may be unreliable for recent schema changes" and hide negative available until resolved?

josh: mitigation path: 1) quick patch in preview-agg to accept v1 or v2 shapes (tiny) 2) feature-flag the parser and canary to two shards 3) console banner + hide-flag for affected orgs until canary passes. If PR not ready in 90m, rollback enrich-service v3.1.0.

erin: I'll own the console banner + identify affected orgs.

josh: I'll open the patch PR and include unit tests for both shapes.

triage-bot: INC-2026-0502-511 created, severity=P2. Owners: erin (console + org list), josh (preview-agg patch), sam (monitoring).

erin: banner up and hide-preview enabled for top 3 reseller orgs. Monitoring shows preview delta starting to trend down for staging tests.

josh: PR opened: https://gh/redwood/preview-agg/pull/2148 feature-flag off by default. Canary scheduled in 45m.

sam: adding short-lived alert: preview_cost/ledger_cost > 5 for resellers. will watch during canary.

erin: thanks all. will update when canary results in prod.
